metadata.title: AgriClimateBD: A Satellite Enriched Precision Agriculture Dataset for Bangladesh
metadata.attribution: Basunia, M. S.; Biswas, J.; Kumar, S. (2026). AgriClimateBD: A Satellite Enriched Precision Agriculture Dataset for Bangladesh, Version 2. Mendeley Data. https://doi.org/10.17632/tb5x9gw2pt.2. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
metadata.phenologyEvidence: Survey-derived crop period summaries. Dataset description reports surveys involving 223 farmers; per-record sample count and survey/collection year are not provided.
metadata.geographicLevel: district as provided in source; no upazila-level records
metadata.periodGranularity: source month labels only; no day-level dates or calendar year
metadata.exclusionReason: Only survey-derived phenology periods are integrated. BBS statistics are outside this task; NASA POWER-derived climate summaries are excluded to prevent duplicate climate ingestion, and their max/min relative-humidity columns are inverted in every source row.
qualityLimitations: Source contains spreadsheet formula error #REF! as a crop name; affected rows are rejected.
Some Growth fields say 'No need to do' and one Harvest wording is misspelled; affected periods remain null and carry quality flags.
Survey year and per-row sample counts are absent; periods are not current forecasts or official guidance.
